scope: Existing host-path material delivery and atomic execution guidance; no new method, no runtime qualification
contract: Node builtins, readonly standalone script, no DB/global config/network/install/model calls
Strict unique known args, positive integers, max bounds; missing or invalid args fail with structured JSON error and nonzero
Only bounded regular UTF8 file; reject final symlink, FIFO and invalid UTF8. Do not claim OS sandbox or concurrent writer fencing. Avoid unbounded read/block on nonregular file.

SHA256 over exact whole file bytes, byte length, LF-based content line count: remove only terminal empty split element; preserve CRLF and original selected bytes in text. Empty file has0lines and first page eoftrue.
start1-based; beyond EOF rejected except empty start1; subsequent start>1 requires caller-supplied exact full-file sha256, mismatch returns no content. First call may pin optionalsha.

JSON has schema_version,path,sha256,file_bytes,total_lines,start,end,text,eof,next_start. eof is page reaches actual file end, not proof model read previous pages or understood. No automatic reading receipt/qualification.
Too much requested text yields bounded explicit error without text; caller may reduce lines. Long single line beyond cap remains unsupported and reported.
Help documents flags/limits; output errors do not leak file content. No changes to exporter manifest schema or dynamic execution permissions.
validation: 64line and65line materials with trailingLF/without LF; default60 then tail with hash, missingtail neverEOF
mixed LF/CRLF, blanklines, unicode byte bounds, emptyfile
content drift betweenpages oldhash refused; identicalsize drift refused; wronghash firstpage refused
invalidflags/duplicates/start/range/invalidUTF8/oversize/symlink/nonregular refused, no stdout content on failure
actual main exports bothhosts: concatenate exact returned pages to originalbytes; no model consumption claims
